notes: Quest-object kinds of "use at a place" objectives (Round 36, docs/design/quests.md). A kind's `texture` is the one texture of its object, drawn as a square sprite `size` nodes wide (default 1). The [fill] textures are placeholders: the art lane's file replaces one row's texture name, nothing else changes. The game (grug_quests/use.lua) and tools/r28_design/validate.py read this file.
